symbols.name: deletion_requested
symbols.description: The user has submitted a request to delete a property.

symbols.name: user_is_owner
symbols.description: The user making the request is the owner of the property.

symbols.name: deletion_confirmed
symbols.description: The user has confirmed the deletion action.

symbols.name: property_deleted
symbols.description: The property has been successfully deleted from the system.

symbols.name: confirmation_prompt_displayed
symbols.description: The system displays a prompt asking the user to confirm the deletion.

symbols.name: property_record_removed
symbols.description: The property record is no longer accessible or visible in the system.

symbols.name: property_record_retained
symbols.description: The property record still exists in the database for audit purposes.

symbols.name: confirmation_message_displayed
symbols.description: The system displays a message confirming the deletion was successful.

symbols.name: redirected_to_property_list
symbols.description: The user's view is redirected to the list of properties.

symbols.name: authorization_error_displayed
symbols.description: The system displays an error message indicating the user is not authorized to perform the action.

background.text: A property record cannot be both removed and retained at the same time.

rules.text: WHEN the owner requests deletion of a Property, THE System SHALL display a confirmation prompt.
rules.reading: If the user is the owner and requests deletion of a property, the system must display a confirmation prompt.

rules.text: WHEN the owner confirms the deletion, THE System SHALL remove the Property record.
rules.reading: The system must ensure the property record is removed whenever the property owner has confirmed the deletion action.

rules.text: WHEN a Property is deleted, THE System SHALL display a confirmation message and redirect the owner to the property list.
rules.reading: When a property is deleted, the system must display a confirmation message and redirect the user to the property list.

rules.text: THE System SHALL implement soft deletion to retain Property records for audit purposes.
rules.reading: The system must ensure that property records are retained for audit purposes when implementing soft deletion.

alternative.reading: The system must ensure that property records are retained in the database for audit purposes when a property is successfully deleted.

rules.text: WHEN a user who is not the owner attempts to delete a Property, THE System SHALL display an authorization error.
rules.reading: The system must display an authorization error whenever a user who is not the owner attempts to delete a property.
